typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DynamicFileName as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	FullPath as string (),
	InboundPath as string (),
	OutboundPath as string (),
	OutputFileName as string (),
	SheetName as string (),
	SheetRange as string (),
	SuccessEmail as string ()
}

source(output(
		OutOfSyncTableName as string,
		ImpactedProcesses as string,
		DateOfIssue as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ResolutionDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive({Copy of OutOfSyncTableName} = OutOfSyncTableName,
		{Copy of DateOfIssue} = toString(DateOfIssue),
		{Copy of ResolutionDate} = toString(ResolutionDate),
		{Copy of ImpactedProcesses} = ImpactedProcesses) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		ImpactedProcesses as string,
		OutOfSyncTableName as string,
		DateOfIssue as string,
		ResolutionDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ImpactedProcesses,
		OutOfSyncTableName,
		DateOfIssue,
		ResolutionDate)) ~> OLEDBDestination
